assets.prompt: Round rotation-friendly 48x48 matte slate-blue hull, five recessed sockets, violet core, dark stepped outlines; grass battlefield as style reference.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PNG sprite for a top-down pixel shooter. Style reference 1 is game terrain ONLY; reference 2 is the approved new player hull for palette and pixel clustering. Single isolated subject, no scene/background, no shadow, no frame/text. Crisp classic pixel clusters, matte finish, clear dark stepped outline, no smoothing, no gradients, no bloom, no micro-noise, no gold ornament. Draw on requested logical grid then enlarge nearest-neighbor. Single top-down modular gun turret facing EXACTLY straight UP, short single straight cannon. Matte slate-blue armor housing matches hull reference; ivory tiny edges and muted violet indicator. Compact base on bottom. NO entire vehicle, no wings. 24x32 logical pixel sprite.
